text:
marta: FYI I'm seeing a spike in login failures for JIT-provisioned users after the role-mapping tweak we pushed last night. Admin role isn't being applied for some accounts. :grimacing:

samir: ugh. which attribute is failing?

marta: looks like we started requiring `employeeNumber` in the mapping rule. If it's absent, the mapping returns null and our fallback was inadvertently removed. Repro steps attached.

marta: sample assertion we got from affected user:
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113730.3.1.3">
    <saml:AttributeValue>John Doe</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <!-- no employeeNumber attribute present -->
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```

leo: was the change part of the role-refactor PR? I thought we had a fallback to org_admin when mapping fails.

anya: PR 4786 changed the mapping to prefer `employeeNumber` for disambiguation across identity sources. I added fallback for `department` but not for missing employeeNumber specifically — my bad.

samir: okay. impact? Which users affected?

marta: mainly SSO users from partners that don't populate employeeNumber. A few internal SREs hit it because their AD sync missed the attr. In prod ~18 failed logins so far, 6 of them were admin perms that caused CI pipelines to fail.

deploy-bot: role-mapping-config v2.1.9 deployed to prod by anya at 2003001200 

samir: can we roll forward a hotfix to reintroduce the fallback? Minimal change: if employeeNumber absent then fall back to `uid` -> `roleLookup`.

anya: on it. patch branch okta/fix-jit-fallback, going to test in staging now.

marta: also let's add an audit flag when JIT mapping fails to assign any role so we can alert earlier. Right now it's just a login error with no RBAC audit event.

leo: +1. Missing RBAC audit events make incident triage slower. We should log a structured event whenever mapping returns empty.

anya: will add both: (1) fallback path, (2) audit event emission to our KMS-auditor pipeline. Quick question: do we tag the audit event with the raw assertion or just hashed attributes? security-bot: Recommended: do NOT log raw PII. Hash employeeNumber/uid and store attribute keys only.

security-bot: security note: ensure audit events are written to the immutable audit stream with server-side KMS encryption and restricted ACLs. If you need KMS key access for the service account, file a request to iam-request.

samir: timeline?

anya: create PR in 10m, testing for 20m, can roll in ~40m if staging looks good. I'll post the PR link once ready.

marta: thanks. I'll notify affected teams and open a short incident ticket to track user restores.

leo: after fix, let's do a short eval run to ensure role mapping doesn't escalate anyone accidentally. Smoke test: users with missing employeeNumber should get non-admin defaults, unless another attribute explicitly maps them to admin.

marta: noted. will run eval with the admin-test-suite.

anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4812 (draft)

samir: great. ping me when deployed, I'll help verify and close the ticket. :thumbsup:
